$comment: Release component pins: where every bundled sidecar and model comes from, and which bytes a release may ship. Read by scripts/build-component.sh (builds or fetches a component at its pin and installs it only if its sha256 matches) and checked by `node scripts/component-pins.mjs check` (CI, node job), which fails when this file, the build scripts, the bundle overlays, src-tauri/runtime-deps.sha256, release.yml and src-tauri/src/model.rs disagree.

Each artifact's digest lives in one place: its own sha256, or, for bytes uploaded to the runtime-deps prerelease, the pin of its runtime_deps_asset in src-tauri/runtime-deps.sha256 (release.yml verifies that pin before staging). Digests are of the bytes staged into src-tauri/binaries before bundling; Tauri then signs each externalBin with the Developer ID, so the copies inside a signed macOS app differ.

macOS cargo builds reproduce byte for byte only on the machine and build root that recorded them (the linker derives the Mach-O UUID from the output path; see scripts/build-component.sh). Linux pins are the 0.5.1 DGX-lane builds (PROVENANCE-linux.txt); the DGX re-pins them with build-component.sh --print-digest before it builds with this script.
federation: the citrate-federation manifest.toml pin of the source repo, and whether it matches. A mismatch is recorded with a note, never silent (Rule 11). Changing any pin is a reviewed PR.
